note: Where readers load published art and audio from. Every asset URL the site emits is built from this one template, so changing the delivery network is a one-line edit here. jsDelivr serves a commit-pinned path as immutable for a year; raw.githubusercontent.com served the same file with max-age=300. The content release (arkpedia-data) deliberately does NOT use this: its pointer must not sit in a long CDN cache.
